## Frequently asked questions

What is the medical process like?

1. Complete an online consultation with your health history and current medications.
2. An independent, licensed provider reviews your information and may ask follow-up questions.
3. If treatment is appropriate, your prescription goes to the pharmacy and your medication ships to your door.
4. Continue your care through your account, including refills and provider messaging.

What is the timeline after approval?

After approval, the pharmacy processes your prescription and ships your medication overnight. Most patients receive medication within a few days of starting their consultation. Learn more about [how it works](https://healthrx.com/how-it-works).

What happens if I’m not approved?

Full refund if a provider does not approve you. There is no charge for a consultation that does not end in treatment.

What is your return policy?

Prescription medications cannot be returned once dispensed. Unopened over-the-counter products may be returned within 30 days after the sale, with return shipping paid by the customer. For damaged or lost items, contact [patient care](mailto:support@healthrx.com). Read our [returns and refund policy](https://healthrx.com/returns-refund-policy) for full details.

Is compounded semaglutide the same as Wegovy or Ozempic?

It is the same active molecule, prepared by a licensed 503A compounding pharmacy rather than a brand manufacturer. Compounded medications are not FDA-approved and are not the same product as the branded versions. Your provider can explain the trade-offs and decide whether the compounded protocol is clinically appropriate for you.

Who actually writes my prescription?

An independent, US-licensed clinician licensed in your state. They make every clinical decision. HealthRX.com does not employ them and does not influence the prescribing decision.
